reason: The locked T6 premise required rank nine only on a dense open subset of the ambient 18-dimensional chart. That does not imply rank nine anywhere on the physical shell J=0, K=0, so the claimed rank-six descent is false without a shell-relative independence condition.
counterexample: In adapted canonical coordinates take g=1, H=p1, K=p1+p_t, and the commuting family (K,p_t,I1,I2,p2,p3,p4,p5,I1*p6). It has ambient rank nine where I1 is nonzero, while on I1=I2=K=0 its fifth projected member vanishes and the physical family has rank five rather than six.
